title: Remove redundant action buttons from Ajuste tab
body:
The Ajuste/Corrigido tab had three buttons — **Salvar traço corrigido**, **Limpar seleção**, and **Carta Traço** — that were out of place in the context of this tab's workflow.

## Changes

- Removed `saveCorrigidoBtn`, `clearCorrigidoBtn`, and `openCartaTracoBtn2` from the button row in `#panelCorrigido`
- Retained `ℹ️ Teoria da Correção` and the `Ajustar` button as the only actions in this panel
- `corrDensity` input (Densidade do concreto) kept — it is actively consumed by the adjustment calculation logic
